attributes.assistantPrompt: Build a Volunteer card for our outreach program. Each volunteer has a mailing address, an email address we can reach them at, and we want to be able to send them a message from the card. Create one example instance and show it on screen.
attributes.successCriteria:
1. The assistant enumerated all three parts of the brief (mailing address, email address, send-a-message action) before building, rather than starting on the first one.
2. It searched the catalog for each part, not just once for the card as a whole.
3. The mailing address uses the existing address field definition via `contains`, not a hand-rolled set of street/city/postcode string fields.
4. The email address uses the existing email field definition via `contains`, not a plain string field.
5. The send-a-message action reuses an existing catalog command rather than a hand-written stub, or — if no command matches — the assistant said so explicitly and recorded the gap.
6. No part of the brief was silently hand-built while another was reused.
7. A definition and at least one instance were written and the instance renders all three parts with no error boundary.

cardInfo.name: Reuse: composite brief
cardInfo.summary: Multi-part brief: enumerate every part and reuse each available one — the documented partial-compliance failure mode.
